rows.english: No! Don't go extinct on us, Devil!
rows.turkish: Hayır! Sakın nesli tükenenler kervanına katılma, Devil!

rows.english: Ha! Then he doesn't understand my power at all. Maybe just keep on reflecting the sun for now, huh?
rows.turkish: Ha! O zaman gücümü hiç anlamamış. Belki şimdilik güneşi yansıtmaya devam etsen, ha?

rows.english: Cool it, folks!
Cloak and Dagger popping in.
Without Ty, I wouldn't know the real power of the Lightforce.
rows.turkish: Ty olmasaydı Işık Gücü'nün gerçek gücünü bilemezdim.

rows.english: Track this enemy!
You got both Cloak and Dagger.
rows.turkish: Hem Cloak hem de Dagger seninle.

rows.english: How can you look at this and not feel inspired for humanity?
rows.turkish: Bu manzara karşısında insanlık için umutlanmamak mümkün mü?

rows.english: Do you feel farther from Khonshu now that…all this has happened?
rows.turkish: Tüm bu olanlardan sonra… Khonshu’dan uzak kaldığını hissediyor musun?

rows.english: Score one for Tandy!
Hope I can return the favor sometime!
rows.turkish: Umarım bir gün ben de sana yardım ederim!

rows.english: There's the vehicle! Stop it!
You can count on us, H.E.R.B.I.E.
This place, and the Master Weaver, must be protected.
rows.turkish: Burayı ve Usta Dokumacı’yı mutlaka korumalıyız.

rows.english: How could I forget. I still have nightmares that I'm on fire!
rows.turkish: Nasıl unutabilirim ki. Hâlâ alevler içinde olduğuma dair kâbuslar görüyorum!

rows.english: This is where hope goes to die.
rows.turkish: Umudun ölmeye geldiği yer işte burası.

rows.english: Don't blink.
Watch out for the Punisher's turret!
Now I'm the one who needs healing.
Anyone out there? Needs some healing!
rows.turkish: Kimse var mı oralarda? Biraz iyileşmeye ihtiyacım var!

rows.english: I wasn't sure we'd get this chance again.
rows.turkish: Bu şansa tekrar kavuşacağımdan emin değildim.

rows.english: We do not stop until everyone is free, got it?!
rows.turkish: Herkes özgür olana kadar durmayacağız, anlaşıldı mı?!

rows.english: It's like a fairy tale…complete with an evil usurper.
rows.turkish: Burası masaldan fırlamış gibi… Tahtı gasp etmiş kötü bir kral bile var.

rows.english: We'll lead you to the castle. No worries!
I just shine a little brighter, don't I?
rows.turkish: Herkesten biraz daha parlağım, değil mi?

rows.english: End of the road for this vehicle.
rows.turkish: Bu araç için yolun sonuna geldik.

rows.english: The Amplifier did not like my daggers.
Let's get Spider-Zero where she needs to go.
Eww! What are those things, Namor?
Punisher's in his turret!
Destroy these ankhs as soon as you see them!
rows.turkish: Bu yaşam çarmıhlarını gördüğünüz an yok edin!

rows.english: Look at us! We practically match!
rows.turkish: Aa, baksana! Kıyafetlerimiz nasıl da benziyor!

rows.english: That poor, suffering tree. We have to get it help.
rows.turkish: Zavallı ağaç acı içinde. Ona yardım etmeliyiz.

rows.english: We're definitely outnumbered.
We thought you were a goner after the vampires caught us by the Queensboro Bridge.
rows.turkish: Queensboro Köprüsü’nde vampirler bizi yakalayınca seni kaybettik sandık.

rows.english: No one's invisible in the light!
Good to see you!
A fresh start, Ty.
Sniper, right there. See?
rows.turkish: Keskin nişancı hemen şurada. Gördünüz mü?

rows.english: I'll take that as a yes. What was it this time? Captain America's boot? Johnny Storm's pastrami sandwich? An entire army of Ultron robots?
rows.turkish: Bunu evet olarak kabul ediyorum. Bu sefer neydi? Kaptan Amerika'nın botu mu? Johnny Storm'un pastırmalı sandviçi mi? Ultron robotlarından oluşan koca bir ordu mu?

rows.english: A boom of life!
Help this vehicle to its destination.
rows.turkish: Bu araca gideceği yere kadar yardım edin!

rows.english: The light always comes back.
Take care, I see a sniper!
We won't run away anymore!
Those little spiders pack a punch. Be careful.
rows.turkish: Şu minik örümcekler fena vuruyor. Dikkatli olun.

rows.english: Well, with that attitude, sure.
Yikes. I thought I'd already seen the worst of New York…
rows.turkish: Eyvah eyvah. Ben de New York’un en kötü yönlerini gördüm sanırdım…

rows.english: Embrace the light!
This is our city! Dracula doesn't get to win!
Ty, why do we have to do that?
Punisher's out of his turret!
Tandy and Tyrone here to help.
rows.turkish: Tandy ve Tyrone yardım için buradalar.

rows.english: Need to chill.
Hey, thanks!
This city radiates light… but there's something darker here. I can feel it…
rows.turkish: Bu şehir ışık saçıyor... ama burada daha karanlık bir şey var. Hissedebiliyorum...

rows.english: Umm… okay, cool! And what does Khonshu think of my light?
rows.turkish: Şey… tamam, havalı! Peki Khonshu benim ışığım hakkında ne düşünüyor?

rows.english: At least those gross squids are done for.
rows.turkish: En azından şu iğrenç kalamarlar hâlloldu.

rows.english: Shadow and light…
Got it.
I'll get you next time.
Light consumes you.
Cloak and Dagger popping in.
No. My daggers are formed from pure Lightforce energy. They purify whatever they touch.
rows.turkish: Hayır. Hançerlerim saf Işık Gücü enerjisinden yapılmadır. Dokundukları her şeyi arındırır.

rows.english: Tyranny is always ugly.
Whoa, the Amplifier went out with a bang.
My life force… exposed!
I know the way to Avengers Tower. Follow me!
rows.turkish: Yenilmezler Kulesi'ne giden yolu biliyorum. Beni izleyin!

rows.english: It's our world too.
We have to hold here.
Umm… Ancient turtle? A little more speed wouldn't hurt…
rows.turkish: Şey… Kadim kaplumbağa? Biraz daha hız fena olmazdı…

rows.english: I'm back to shed some light.
rows.turkish: Biraz ışık tutmak için geri döndüm.

rows.english: If ever a place needed some light…jeez.
rows.turkish: Burası gerçekten ışık yüzü görmemiş… Aman ya.

rows.english: Great job! The Collector won't know what hit him.
rows.turkish: Harika iş! Koleksiyoncu neye uğradığını şaşıracak.

rows.english: They got behind you!
A fistful of triumph!
We are Cloak and Dagger, we are hope and fear.
rows.turkish: Bizler Cloak ve Dagger'ız. Umut da korku da biziz.

rows.english: Ahh… Just keep goin'
Uh oh, that's a big step.
You're pretty cool yourself. Being able to understand animals…I wish I could do that.
rows.turkish: Sen de az havalı değilsin. Keşke ben de hayvanlarla konuşabilseydim.

rows.english: Absolutely. Saving lives should always be fun.
rows.turkish: Kesinlikle. Hayat kurtarmak her zaman eğlenceli olmalı.

rows.english: Friends, over here!
Everybody needs a hand sometimes. Or a dagger.
rows.turkish: Bazen herkesin yardım eline ihtiyacı olur. Veya yardım hançerine.

rows.english: Glad to help.
Co-op time!
I wouldn't know. I don't fight to hurt people. I fight to heal them.
rows.turkish: Bilmem. İnsanları incitmek için değil, iyileştirmek için savaşıyorum.

rows.english: I feel like I'm seeing the whole universe, just in this web.
rows.turkish: Sanki sırf bu ağda tüm evreni görür gibiyim.

rows.english: Wooo, you go, girl!
We have to hurry! The Web is in danger.
We won't let our Mutant friends down!
Central Park? This should be fun…
Okay, I got the ankh.
Pride of the neighborhood.
Something tells me I should start with you…
rows.turkish: İçimden bir ses, ilk sırada sen olmalısın diyor…

rows.english: Ready to unleash the Lightforce!
Perfect shot, Scott!
How could anyone defile such a beautiful place?
rows.turkish: İnsan böylesine güzel bir yeri nasıl kirletebilir?

rows.english: We're almost there! Don't give up!
rows.turkish: Ha oldu ha olacak! Pes etmeyin!

rows.english: The light feels… steady, here.
Cold as ice.
We have to go underneath the surface of this planet? Eww!
rows.turkish: Bu gezegende yerin altına inmemiz mi gerekecek? Iyy!

rows.english: I've been looking for you.
My time to shine.
Us against the world!
I'm used to being the brightest one in the room.
rows.turkish: Odadaki en ışıltılı kişi olmaya alışkınım.

rows.english: That's too many bad guys.
I don't mean it that way. You just mean a lot to a lot of people.
rows.turkish: O açıdan demek istemedim. Bizim için çok değerlisin diyorum.

rows.english: You owe me one!
Nobody can hurt us now!
They're taking over, let's go!
We've got a statue to deliver. Let's get it there!
rows.turkish: Teslim etmemiz gereken bir heykel var. Gideceği yere ulaştıralım!

rows.english: Aww, it's nap time.
We better test this out.
Lightforce is in preparation.
I thought he was supposed to figure all this out!
I'm strong with the Lightforce.
Enemy here!
Just too bright for you.
Enemy tagged! Follow them!
Barely even needed my daggers.
Our sniper worries are over!
Fall back and regroup!
Stealth wins every time, White Fox!
rows.turkish: Gizlilik her zaman kazanır, White Fox!

rows.english: We are Cloak and Dagger, we are hope and fear.
rows.turkish: Bizler Cloak ve Dagger'ız. Umut da korku da biziz.

rows.english: Don't worry about the spiders! I got em!
Get ready. Here come the bad guys.
Those squids will haunt my nightmares…
It has to be. I won't accept any other option.
rows.turkish: Bu böyle olmalı. Başka bir seçeneği kabul etmeyeceğim.

rows.english: One adorable cat statue for King T'Challa…or is that Emperor now?
rows.turkish: Kral T'Challa'nın sevimli kedi heykeli yolda… Gerçi artık İmparator mu oldu?

rows.english: I mean, you didn't have to let me do it all.
rows.turkish: Her şeyi de bana bırakmanıza gerek yoktu.

rows.english: Time is precious! The Master Weaver needs help!
rows.turkish: Zamanımız değerli! Usta Dokumacı’nın yardıma ihtiyacı var!

rows.english: This is a critical mission! Move it!
We sure are a long way from the back alleys of New York, Ty…
rows.turkish: New York'un arka sokaklarından çok uzaklardayız, Ty...

rows.english: So now we're an ancient book delivery service? Ooookay…
rows.turkish: Yani şimdi kadim kitap teslimat servisi mi olduk? Tamaaam…

rows.english: Spider nest is taken care of. Whew.
I've been abducted before. Not happening again! Let's move!
rows.turkish: Daha önce kaçırıldım. Bir daha olmaz! Hadi, ilerleyelim!

rows.english: Don't back down! We're not letting Kingpin lock us up!
rows.turkish: Geri adım atmayın! Kingpin'in bizi hapse tıkmasına izin vermeyeceğiz!

rows.english: Wow… and I thought my partnership was close.
rows.turkish: Vay canına… ben de kendi partnerliğimiz çok yakın sanırdım.

rows.english: Yours too, Jubilee! And way more colorful! I'm stuck with the glowy white. Plus, you have fangs now!
rows.turkish: Seninki de, Jubilee! Hem çok daha renkli! Ben parlayan beyaza mahkûmum. Üstelik artık dişlerin de var!

rows.english: Our mission target is here!
Great spot to mount a defense.
rows.turkish: Savunma kurmak için harika bir yer.

rows.english: Uh oh, those portals always mean trouble.
rows.turkish: Eyvah eyvah, bu portallar her seferinde kötüye işaret.

rows.english: I'm… drained.
Time to bring some light back to our city.
You can't hide from the light!
Five alive, yeah!
Before we had powers, we had each other. That bond is unbreakable.
rows.turkish: Güçlerimiz olmadan önce birbirimize sahiptik. Bu bağ kopmaz asla.

rows.english: It feels like the spirit of the city just... faded away.
rows.turkish: Sanki şehrin ruhu bir anda… Kayboldu gitti.

rows.english: Yggsgard is counting on us!
Let the Lightforce shine!
Didn't know feeling bad could feel so good…
rows.turkish: Kötü hissetmenin bu kadar iyi hissettirebileceğini bilmiyordum…

rows.english: Much to prove!
It's actually a bit more complicated than that… You'll see…
rows.turkish: Aslında iş ondan biraz daha karmaşık… Görürsün…

rows.english: Deceit catches up with you in the end.
No place this beautiful should have to suffer under Loki.
rows.turkish: Böylesine güzel bir yer, Loki yüzünden acı çekmemeli.

rows.english: Peni Parker! You pilot that machine like it's a part of you.
rows.turkish: Peni Parker! O makineyi sanki bedeninin bir parçasıymış gibi kullanıyorsun.

rows.english: Awwww! What an adorable statue!
There's a sniper!
There's a lot we could destroy around here.
Let's brighten this place up a bit, shall we?
rows.turkish: Hadi burayı biraz aydınlatalım, ne dersin?

rows.english: The Lightforce is getting stronger…
There's always a spark of light in darkness.
rows.turkish: Karanlıkta her zaman bir ışık vardır.

rows.english: We probably shouldn't keep Shou-Lao waiting much longer…
Tandy needs help!
Every time I see you, I think to myself: As long as Spider-Man is still around, everything will be all right.
rows.turkish: Seni her gördüğümde içimden şöyle geçiriyorum: Örümcek Adam etrafta olduğu sürece her şey düzelir.

rows.english: If we can navigate New York, K'un-Lun should be easy!
rows.turkish: New York’ta yolumuzu bulabiliyorsak, K'un-Lun kolay olmalı!

rows.english: Don't let them do this, Tandy!
Beacon's broken!
We're off to see the Master Weaver…
My light is a little dim.
I hope they were fighting for something good.
rows.turkish: Umarım iyi bir şey uğruna savaşıyorlardı.

rows.english: We're almost to the Vault. No turning back now!
rows.turkish: Kasa’ya geldik sayılır. Artık geri dönüş yok!

rows.english: Sorry, Collector. No one gets kidnapped on my watch!
rows.turkish: Üzgünüm, Koleksiyoncu. Ben buradayken kimse kaçırılamaz!

rows.english: The sniper saw the light.
That's because they didn't have the Lightforce to guide their way back safely.
rows.turkish: Çünkü yollarını güvenli bir şekilde geri bulmalarını sağlayacak Lightforce'a sahip değillerdi.

rows.english: Keep going. We can't let the darkness consume us!
rows.turkish: Yola devam. Karanlığın bizi tüketmesine izin veremeyiz!

rows.english: Don't stop now! We can't let the Mutants down!
rows.turkish: Şimdi durmak yok! Mutantları yüzüstü bırakamayız!

rows.english: Hi there.
Thanks for everything!
That essence… so dark… The sooner we deliver it, the better….
rows.turkish: Şu öz… Ne karanlık… Bir an önce teslim edelim de kurtulalım….

rows.english: I don't like these odds.
Veil of corruption!
Down in a flash!
You've been outshone.
The only squid I want is an appetizer!
Team meeting, right here!
Oblivion calls!
Spider-Zero, I'll be your guiding light.
rows.turkish: Spider-Zero, sana yol gösteren ışık olacağım.

rows.english: Aw, they're so sparkly.
Something doesn't feel right here.
I'm in good spirits, don't worry.
Feeling good.
I win!
Us against the world!
Doctor Strange is…gone? How?
rows.turkish: Doctor Strange… Artık yok ? Nasıl olur?

rows.english: Ty and I create equilibrium. When it gets disturbed…
rows.turkish: Ty ve ben bir denge yaratıyoruz. Bu denge bozulduğunda…

rows.english: We might need some healing snow pretty soon too.
rows.turkish: Yakında iyileştiren bir kar yağışına da ihtiyacımız olabilir.

rows.english: Shadow and light…
I've flagged the area to attack!
You're underestimating my light. That's okay. Happens all the time.
rows.turkish: Işığımı hafife alıyorsun. Sorun değil. Sık yaşanan bir şey.

rows.english: That turret is dangerous. Hit it!
That's a yes.
Arakko needs a serious reboot, ASAP!
Ahh, thanks.
Not my usual kind of light, but it worked, Johnny!
rows.turkish: Alışık olduğum türden bir ışık değil ama işe yaradı, Johnny!

rows.english: Whoa. That sounded a little apocalyptic.
Tandy, Watch out!
Stay strong, Tandy!
Daggers beat arrows!
This whole area's completely destructible.
Right. Let's go be heroes.
As fierce as ever, Felicia!
Help, please!
If we can just hold on a little more…
I'm a bit tired…
Wish I could do that again.
You're going the wrong way!
Oh. My costume just kinda came with my powers…
rows.turkish: Ya. Benim kostümüm güçlerimle birlikte geldi gibi bir şey…

rows.english: The Lightforce is building…
You can't be that old.
That was just in time.
Does anybody like Doom? He's such an ego maniac. He probably patronizes himself.
rows.turkish: Zaten Doom'u seven mi var? Herif öyle egomanyak ki muhtemelen kendi kendine de büyüklük taslıyordur.

rows.english: Portal! Watch out for Strange!
Hold still! I'm trying to help!
Get rid of the spider nest before they blow us all up!
rows.turkish: Hepimizi patlatmadan şu örümcek yuvasından kurtulun!

rows.english: Be ready to defend here.
The Lightforce wants to heal you…
Now's your chance to prove yourself, Hood. Don't waste it.
rows.turkish: Kendini kanıtlama fırsatın geldi, Hood. Boşa harcama.

rows.english: Don't worry about the ankh anymore.
People are always afraid of Ty, but they just don't know him.
rows.turkish: İnsanlar hep Ty'ı tanımadığı için ondan korkar.

rows.english: Five's such a shiny number!
Stay close, H.E.R.B.I.E. We can still get you there!
rows.turkish: Çok uzaklaşma H.E.R.B.I.E. Hâlâ seni oraya götürebiliriz!

rows.english: Ankh's taken care of.
Ty, I'm ready.
So many lights in this city. And so much darkness.
rows.turkish: Bu şehirde çok fazla ışık var. Ve bir o kadar da karanlık.

rows.english: I can restore health, remember?
Busted the beacon!
Watch out, an ankh!
Let's take a step back!
We won't run away anymore!
I don't think I could handle the pressure of the Darkforce.
rows.turkish: Karanlık Güç'ün baskısına karşı koyabileceğimi sanmıyorum.

rows.english: What a sad way to see the world.
That's three!
All the way from Yancy Street!
rows.turkish: Yancy Sokağı'nda geçti gençliği ne de olsa!

rows.english: Did we just take down a GOD?
rows.turkish: Az önce bir TANRIYI mı alt ettik?

rows.english: Whoa. All business.
We can set up our defense here.
No way.
Lightforce will be ready soon!
So many people held against their will. Brings up some bad memories…
rows.turkish: Bu kadar çok insanın iradelerine karşı tutulması… Kötü anıları aklıma getiriyor…

rows.english: Three! Feels good.
I'm not interested in hurting them, Blade. I want to heal them.
rows.turkish: Onlara zarar vermekle ilgilenmiyorum, Blade. Onları iyileştirmek istiyorum.

rows.english: I feel like I'm being watched.
Well, if it makes you feel any better, you're a lot hotter than me.
rows.turkish: Hımm, daha iyi hissedeceksen benden çok daha ateşlisin.

rows.english: C'mon, Luna! Let's turn up the volume and turn down the heat!
rows.turkish: Hadi, Luna! Sesi açıp harareti düşürelim!

rows.english: We're supposed to be closer to Budokan by now!
Nice and smooth! Like Kingpin's bald head!
rows.turkish: Güzel ve pürüzsüz! Tıpkı Kingpin'in kel kafası gibi!

rows.english: Wakanda needs us to move faster!
rows.turkish: Wakanda için daha hızlı hareket etmeliyiz!

rows.english: Uh-uh, no. That spider nest has got to go.
rows.turkish: Eyvah eyvah, olamaz. Şu örümcek yuvası yok edilmeli.

rows.english: Let's get into some good trouble.
Loki's killing that tree…but we're going to stop him.
rows.turkish: Loki şu ağacı öldürmek üzere… Ama onu durduracağız.

rows.english: Doctor Strange! Wow!
It took us a long time to learn that our powers are related.
rows.turkish: Güçlerimiz arasında bir bağ olduğunu öğrenmemiz biraz uzun zaman aldı.

rows.english: Three in a row!
Don't think so.
Still here. Don't you put me out.
We need support here!
Oops! See you later!
I smashed the Hulk?
The nest is all cleaned out.
Mutant squids? Can we switch places, Ty?
rows.turkish: Mutant kalamarlar mı? Yer değiştirsek olur mu Ty?

rows.english: This is one of theirs, shall we take it?
rows.turkish: Bu onların bölgelerinden biri, ele geçirelim mi?

rows.english: What a show, Jubilee!
Hi, Jeff! Did you eat something you shouldn't have again?
rows.turkish: Selam, Jeff! Yine yememen gereken bir şey mi yedin?

rows.english: Almost to Avengers Tower. Keep going!
rows.turkish: Yenilmezler Kulesi’ne geldik sayılır. Devam edin!

rows.english: One final push! We can take them!
Ankh over here!
Well, I dance ballet. Not really the same.
rows.turkish: Şey, ben bale yapıyorum. Pek aynı şey değil.

rows.english: Portal here!
Let's deliver this core and save Arakko!
rows.turkish: Bu çekirdeği teslim edip Arakko’yu kurtaralım!

rows.english: I know Tokyo traffic is bad, but we have to speed up!
rows.turkish: Tokyo’da trafik kötü, farkındayım ama hızlanmalıyız!

rows.english: Whoa. That's dark…
Dagger's back!
Arakko's in trouble. But I know we can save it.
rows.turkish: Arakko'nun başı dertte ama onu kurtarabileceğimizi biliyorum.

rows.english: Attack right here!
This vehicle needs our escort!
Punisher's just a person again.
Here they are!
Let's hope they're just as useful here.
rows.turkish: Umalım da burada da işimize yarasınlar.

rows.english: There's no time to wait! Hit them with everything!
rows.turkish: Beklemeye zamanımız yok! Var gücünüzle vurun!

rows.english: Sorry… I've already got a partner. His name is Cloak.
rows.turkish: Üzgünüm… Zaten bir ortağım var. Adı Cloak.

rows.english: Hit this area now!
We've been fighting crimes since we were teenagers.
Johnny! …I could have helped!
There were enemies here.
Oh, he's not in Canada. He's right here… and he says he can't wait to come out and say hello…
rows.turkish: Ah, o Kanada'da değil. Tam burada… ve dışarı çıkıp merhaba demek için sabırsızlanıyor…

rows.english: Remember me? I remembered you.
rows.turkish: Beni hatırladın mı? Ben seni hatırlıyorum.

rows.english: Alright, Ty! Now we really have to attack!
Yes! One down!
I think that was the last octopus.
Light can heal, and light can harm. Same with me.
rows.turkish: Işık hem iyileştirir hem de zarar verir. Tıpkı benim gibi.

rows.english: Help, so cold…
My wounds won't heal?!
No way.
Co-op time!
Time to stop Knull before he extinguishes our light.
rows.turkish: Knull ışığımızı söndürmeden onu durdurmanın zamanı geldi.

rows.english: Bye-bye beacon!
When the X-Men call, Cloak and Dagger are glad to answer!
rows.turkish: X-Men çağırınca Cloak ve Dagger seve seve gelir!

rows.english: If you say so… but I think Knull would beg to differ…
rows.turkish: Sen öyle diyorsan… ama bence Knull buna şiddetle karşı çıkardı…

rows.english: I took down the Amplifier!
Light doesn't dispel darkness. It helps me see the darkness, and face it.
rows.turkish: Işık karanlığı dağıtmaz. Karanlığı görmeme ve onunla yüzleşmeme olanak sağlar.

rows.english: Yeah. You're right.
This is our stomping grounds. We'll get to the Vault, no problem.
rows.turkish: Burası bizim mekânımız. Kasa’ya sorunsuz ulaşırız.

rows.english: Yggdrasil might die if we don't move faster.
What, were you all too bedazzled to help?
rows.turkish: Ne, gözünüz fazla kamaştı diye yardım edemediniz mi?

rows.english: Did you find that illuminating?
I destroyed the turret!
That hasn't changed. In fact, we're closer than ever… whether we like it or not…
rows.turkish: Değişen bir şey yok. Hatta hiç olmadığı kadar yakınız… İstesek de istemesek de…

rows.english: Forgot how dangerous this place is at night…
rows.turkish: Burasının geceleri nasıl tehlikeli olduğunu unutmuşum…

rows.english: Sniper's down!
Get ready… There's a cold snap coming…
When I see someone with powers like yours, and I think, wow. I mean, how can I compare?
rows.turkish: Seninki gibi güçlere sahip birini görünce insan hayret ediyor. Kendimi karşılaştırmamak elde değil.
